title: Fix
description: One remedy attached to a twin (RFC §5.1.2). A fix MUST carry at least one of `apply` or `docs`: `apply` is the corrected invocation expressed in the provider's own already-shipped call schema, `docs` names a corpus topic and is inert by construction. Within a twin, `fixes` is ordered most-likely-first.

title.description: What this fix does, in one line.

apply.description: The corrected invocation, in the provider's own call schema. Deliberately untyped: the shape belongs to the provider, not to this spec. A fix MUST NOT introduce shapes, commands, or operations the provider does not already define; that constraint is enforced by the schema-bound-fixes gate, not expressible here.

docs.description: A corpus topic (RFC §5.2) that explains the fix's territory. A topic name, nothing more.

confidence.description: How sure the provider is, in the RFC's three-value vocabulary.
